description: Main entry point for the Wordle front-end application built with Flutter. Sets up environment variables, initializes the app, and provides the root widget that manages state via GameController and controls navigation to the GameScreen.

classes.name: WordleApp
classes.description: Root widget of the application, sets up theme and state management with GameController.

classes.name: _Root
classes.description: Widget that observes the game controller to decide whether to show a loading indicator or the GameScreen.

methods.name: _safeLoadEnv
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a .env file asynchronously, ignoring errors if the file is missing.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Asynchronous main function that initializes Flutter bindings, loads environment variables, and runs the app.
